name: JK Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: JK Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale of decorative plywood, building materials, and housing equipment in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: General Building Materials Wholesale; General Building Materials Retail; and Plywood Manufacturing and Wood Processing. The company manufactures and sells ordinary, secondary, structural, and long plywood; plywood-based products; veneer; laminated veneer, timber, and lumber; laminated processed products; wood products; logs; building materials; and home appliances.
